text: In Cap-Haitien's markets, a vendor's bank is a school notebook. Sales on one page, what the neighbours took on credit on another. Credit gets forgotten. And when a lender asks, show me your sales, there is nothing clean to show. About two billion people work like this.

Kaye, which means notebook in Haitian Creole, reads that notebook for her. It is built on Firebase AI Logic hybrid inference: Gemini Nano on the device first, Gemini in the cloud only when it should, and only with what it needs.
No sign-up wall at a market stall. Tap try it now, and Firebase Authentication gives you a private notebook in seconds, with six weeks of sample sales, stored in Firestore.

Here is a handwritten sales page. One tap, and Gemini Nano reads the photo right here in Chrome, on this laptop, with no graphics card. Then Kaye checks the math. Every line, quantity times price, and the page total. Rice, beans, oil, sugar. Twenty one hundred. It all adds up. And the badge says it: on this device. The photo never left the computer.

This page has a mistake. The total says thirty eight sixty, but the lines add up to thirty seven sixty. Kaye does not guess. It shows exactly what is wrong. A photo cannot have names removed, so before anything goes to the cloud, it asks. Her photo, her choice.

Vendors can also just write it, the way they talk, in Kreyòl. Gemini Nano is not validated for Kreyòl yet, so this note goes to the cloud. But first Kaye replaces the customers' names on the device. Gemini only sees C one and C two. The names come back when the answer returns.
Who owes me keeps a running list of credit. One tap writes a polite reminder, and the AI never sees the customer's name.
And at the end of the month, a clean record for the lender. Sales by week, best sellers, and a short summary written from totals only. Kaye keeps records. It never gives financial advice.

The same engine runs on Android, with Gemini Nano through Firebase AI Logic. Here on a phone without a local model, Kaye asks before using the cloud, reads the page, and verifies the total. With no signal, Firestore keeps every line on the phone and syncs when the signal comes back.
Six Firebase products carry the whole app: AI Logic, Firestore, Authentication, Remote Config, Analytics, and App Check. No backend of our own. Kaye. Your notebook, now it can count.
